shared: Draw ONE professional pixel-art animation plate of SIX consecutive drawings for a small coding pet, using uploaded image 1 as EXACT model reference and uploaded image 2 for reference prop vocabulary. Output a LANDSCAPE 1536x1024 sheet, invisible precise 3 columns x 2 rows of equal SQUARE cells. Each of six cells shows its own WHOLE complete scene with breathing room all sides; no gaps from props beyond cell boundaries. Solid ultra-saturated bright cyan #00FFFF keyed background throughout and in every hole, no ground, lines, dividers or captions. No cyan colors in any sprite itself. Dark crisp terraced outlines, very LOW resolution pixel clusters enlarged, 3/4 view facing RIGHT. Match the deadpan low brow, broad tan muzzle, round ears, pear belly, big flat feet, single fully attached curved long tail, warm chestnut brown fur, pale apricot skin and peach belly panel. Keep fur colors confined to monkey fur; props other than monkey use fixed beige/gray/green/yellow/red; yellow bananas have charcoal tips. NO brown-toned props or facial hair. No badges, bubbles or text except where expressly requested. Preserve object, character and foot scale across every drawing, remove superfluous FX. Weight/contact, strong line of action, silhouette, anticipation, overshoot, follow-through and hold must tell the joke in six stills. Feet and stationary props are aligned to the same ground in each frame. Eye direction matters. Read the six frames in normal reading order across rows. Action:

actions.working: Sorting bananas. SAME two small banana piles on a low flat beige work surface in front of monke, with GREEN-tipped bunches left and ripe YELLOW bunches right. This is deliberation and sorting. No containers, crate carrying or walking. Poses: 1 hands hover over a mixed pile, suspicious glance at two bunches. 2 lift one large slightly green curved bunch. 3 rotate and scrutinize it with exaggerated deliberation. 4 reach across, place it on a matching pile with obvious hand contact. 5 compare a new straight banana against one already sorted. 6 hesitate and take the SAME mixed bunch back to reclassify. Nearly identical static arrangement, visible transfer/change between piles, use contrast of green and yellow.
actions.inspecting: Tiny detective intensely inspects a single suspicious loose screw through a huge unmistakable ROUND magnifying glass on a dark gray handle. 1 monke notices one silver screw at foot. 2 lifts lens up and leans towards screw. 3 leans closer, face behind lens; hold lens between visible eye and screw. 4 leans so close one eye appears enlarged in glass. 5 squints and nudges screw with free index finger under the lens, lens wobbles. 6 is absolutely certain he found something (raised brow as he looks again). Fixed screw on low beige work block; flat leaf-green tinted transparent glass with cream glint, WHITE eye and black pupil visible through it, NEVER CYAN. No telescope, keyboard, notebook, hat or coat. Keep lens close to eye and screw.
actions.executing: Vintage office control with long steel lever and red cylindrical handle on riveted beige base at monkey's right; keep base and pivot bolted at bottom right, same pixel coordinates in every frame. Camera points at lever from side. Six frames: 1 monkey eyes raised red grip with confidence; tall lever shaft is CANTED RIGHT. 2 both hands reach and clasp red GRIP; 3 strains leaning left, shoulders down, knees braced, hands maintain contact with grip at same instant shaft begins rotating counterclockwise; 4 pulls lever THROUGH its arc to CANTED LEFT end; monkey and gripping hand recoil jointly at the stop; 5 let go and hunches down near lever, hand shielding ear and squints, bracing for consequences. 6 peeks with one eye. Lever stays in pulled position through frames 4-6. No red button and no text.
actions.building: Building a tower out of BANANA blocks under an oversized yellow hardhat. On-screen right is a stable growing tower of bright yellow crescent-ended studded blocks with visible rectangular bases, chunky game art; distinct from actual loose fruit. Hat worn all six frames on the same monkey. 1 proud worker grips block low, beside one installed base block. 2 bends knees and lifts heavy block to eye level; 3 stretches up, puts it on top of base; 4 tower wobbles and oversized helmet slips over one eye; 5 he catches tower with one hand and lifts helmet brim with other, 6 helmet level and straightened tower, proudly salutes. Keep relative scale; only two or three manageable large blocks, no ladders or other tools. Readability at tiny size.
actions.transferring: Two FIXED separated shallow small baskets on ground, left basket with a clear rightward-arrow badge and a few yellow bananas, right basket with a big checkmark badge and initially empty. Rims green/gray. Both baskets visible in all cells with stable floor positions. One regular crescent banana is the transferred payload. 1 monkey between baskets leans LEFT with empty hands. 2 lifts ONE banana with both hands from left basket. 3 pivots with it against chest, one foot steps across. 4 steps right and extends banana toward right basket; 5 places banana inside, fingers opening so banana now sits behind the destination rim; 6 empty hands turns back and sets off for another. Only one monkey, enough space to distinguish each state, single payload drawn exactly once. No long text.
actions.researching: TODDLER-SIZED brass telescope fixed on gray short tripod at right aimed upward RIGHT away from monkey. Monkey on left with cream small notepad and yellow pencil. 1 peers through small rear eyepiece of tube, opposite big objective points toward upper right. 2 squints and adjusts focus ring with hand, feet fixed. 3 pulls face from telescope and straightens, eyes widen at discovery. 4 flips open notebook, holds pencil with excruciating solemnity. 5 hunches and WRITES an ambitious stroke on the paper, pencil actually contacting it. 6 finishes flourish, holds notebook up with a dead-serious nod. Keep the stationary telescope in ALL panels; a few visible pencil strokes and all props clear. No magnifying glass.
actions.coordinating: Manager Monke directs a tiny junior while standing LEFT of one large unfolded cream MAP on a gray board at right. Only TWO monkeys, parent full-size and matching helper half-height. Same-scale master MONKE faces board, points authoritatively, mini helper crouches at bottom right near corner. No furniture besides map board. Simple map has strong orientable markers: large GREEN upright tree and red route arrow. 1 map is UPSIDE-DOWN (tree points downward), parent studies it. 2 parent taps incorrect upside-down marker with long pointing arm, chin up. 3 parent turns face outward grandly while helper grabs map corner, starts rotating sheet. 4 helper rotates through a clear DIAGONAL 90-degree angle while parent's eyes remain on viewer. 5 map now right-side up (tree canopy up, route arrow up); parent turns back and points proudly at proper route. 6 helper steps back quietly, hands off, parent takes credit. Keep helper aligned and board fixed, maps correctly staged, no extra bananas or signs.
actions.external: Tiny utility: a single fixed steel crane with pulley and a white puffy cloud overhead on the right, rope and gray bucket running up towards cloud. Monke operates on LEFT. Cartoon joke cloud computing. Visible angular question-mark on a LEAF note and a BIG green checkmark on the answer note; no text otherwise. Keep frames spatially consistent. 1 kneels to load a QUESTION into bucket at ground level. 2 pulls rope down with both hands, eyes on bucket now HALFWAY UP shaft. 3 taut rope; bucket NOW UP IN CLOUD, monkey leans back from hauling. 4 lowers bucket, NOW HALFWAY DOWN containing green checkmarked ANSWER. 5 holds answer note triumphantly while bucket back on floor. 6 answer rests atop bucket, monkey CLAPS BOTH hands in front of chest and smiles as if he had done all the thinking. Distinct bucket heights and hands. Stay compact so both objects readable at native size.
actions.parallel: Confidently multitasking with THREE tiny battered beige keyboards. NO SCREENS. Two SMALL keyboards at hip height, one at LEFT for left hand, one at RIGHT for right hand; third distinct keyboard ON FLOOR IN FRONT of feet. Place upper keyboards on simple gray stands with minimum supporting shapes. Monkey sits, arms stretch wide, bare FEET reach floor keyboard. Keep all 3 keyboards separately visible in ALL SIX frames, aligned consistently. 1 hover in readiness, feet poised. 2 left hand strikes keyboard L while right hand raised. 3 right hand strikes keyboard R while left raised. 4 in an obvious arc lifts one foot high, both hands poised. 5 foot stomps keyboard 3 while hands press both upper boards; compressing pose. 6 rebounds with both hands and one foot hovered and a smug grin. Only two arms and two feet. No extra decorations.
actions.compacted: Context compaction. A tiny recognizable coconut FILING CABINET at right: half coconut textured TAN shell around a beige METAL drawer with a handle. A tall messy mountain of off-white leaf notes at left of open drawer almost hides the tiny cabinet. Camera and cabinet anchored. 1 monkey eyes pile, opens drawer with raised brow. 2 scoops stack taller than his head, leans back with load. 3 tips pile into tiny open drawer, papers BOW outward comically and are partly inserted. 4 leans both forearms down on stack with whole body weight, compressing pile visibly into tiny drawer. 5 shoves drawer closed, then releases with one tiny note still protruding. 6 deliberately pokes last note in with one finger and stands smugly beside the neat fully closed cabinet. No other cabinets, flames or clutter. Coconut fixed prop hue light ochre/yellow beige with gray metal, not monkey fur brown.
